title: 第004章 下山第005章 半路救美女
content_zh:
;;
秦延军很是疑惑，师傅这隐瞒的本事还真是不一般，18年了，从来没有提起过。
只见老乞丐又说道。
“徒儿，我知道你18年前被人追杀，秦雨水保护你，差点丢了性命，做人不能够忘本，希望你以后好好的孝敬他。”
“徒儿，知道了。18年前追杀我们的人，我想去追查，然后报仇。另外，我的母亲是否健在？”秦延军心中有些伤感，但是没有忘记母亲拼命为自己和水叔争取逃命的时间。
说到这里，老乞丐拿出一块黑乎乎的牌子。
“这是‘护龙殿’令牌，需要的时候可以去‘护龙殿’，拿出令牌，可以得到他们的帮助。现在的‘护龙殿’，是由你三师姐罗青青主持，有时间了也可以去看看她。”
“今天说了这么多，臭小子，明日你就下山去吧？”
说完，一个闪身便没有了踪影。
原地只留下了秦延军在发呆，心中想着师傅今天说的话。
“18年了，妈妈，等着我！”
翌日清晨。
一名二十出头的年轻人突然出现在山道上。
此人，俊秀飘逸，一米七的个子，长头发在头上没有章法的挽着，上身穿百搭衣，下身黑青色麻布裤子，脚踩兽皮鞋，腰间一边酒葫芦，一边百宝袋。
此时，手上拿着一根刚抽出来的狗尾巴草，嘴上还叼着一根。此人正是在山上修炼18年的秦延军。
江海。
龙威集团总裁办公室。
吴茉莉任集团总裁，此人，时年55岁，虽然50多岁的人，因为是修炼者，再加上保养的好，看起来也就40出头。
秘书长刘紫嫣站在办公桌前，此人在龙威集团工作了20年，看起来也就30几岁，因为保养的好，也得到过吴茉莉传授修炼者功法。所以看起来很年轻，实际年龄，45岁。是吴茉莉的得力助手，工作兢兢业业，认真负责，绝对的忠诚。
“紫嫣，今日我小师弟下山，也不知道他什么时候能到。”吴茉莉突然说道。

听到总裁突然说出这么一句，作为秘书长的刘紫嫣有些惊讶！
“总裁，您还有小师弟，从来没有听你提起过？”
吴茉莉反问道：“嗯！是我师傅18年前在燕京的街上救下来的，还记得我曾经同你说过秦雨水遭遇吗？”
刘紫嫣思索了一阵，“总裁，您曾经同我谈起过！说是为了保护一个被追杀的小孩，半路上被救！难道你的小师弟就是那个小孩？”
“没错，秦雨水是他母亲的仆人，现在想起来了吧？这次他下山可能会去燕京报仇。”吴茉莉猜测道！
刘紫嫣问道：“总裁，那我们怎么办？需不需要做一些前期准备工作？”
吴茉莉略微思索说道：“这样吧！尽量收集资金，或许小师弟应该能用得上。另外，给他准备一套高档别墅。”
停顿了一下，又道：“帮我通知一下朱总经理，让他到我办公室来一趟。”
“好的，我现在就去。”刘紫嫣答应一声，转身离去。
可是，刚出门就碰上了朱景荣。
“朱总，总裁让我通知你去一下她的办公室。”刘紫嫣急忙说道。
“哦！刚好我也要去见她！刘秘书长，总裁有没有说是什么事情找我？”

Qin Yanjun was very puzzled. The master's ability to conceal things was really extraordinary. He had never mentioned it in 18 years.
The old beggar said again.
"Disciple, I know that you were hunted down 18 years ago. Qin Yuyu protected you and almost lost your life. You can't forget your roots as a human being. I hope you will honor him well in the future."
"Disciple, I understand. I want to track down the people who hunted us 18 years ago and take revenge. Also, is my mother still alive?" Qin Yanjun felt a little sad in his heart, but he did not forget that his mother fought hard to buy time for himself and Uncle Shui to escape.
Having said this, the old beggar took out a dark sign.
"This is the 'Dragon Protecting Hall' token. When you need it, you can go to the 'Dragon Protecting Hall' and take out the token to get their help. The current 'Dragon Protecting Hall' is hosted by your third senior sister Luo Qingqing. You can go and see her when you have time."
"I've said so much today, brat, why don't you go down the mountain tomorrow?"
After saying that, he disappeared without a trace.
Only Qin Yanjun was left in a daze, thinking about what his master said today.
"It's been 18 years, mom, wait for me!"
The next morning.
A young man in his early twenties suddenly appeared on the mountain road.
This man is handsome and elegant, about 1.7 meters tall, with long hair tied untidyly on his head. He wears versatile clothes on his upper body, black and blue linen trousers on his lower body, animal skin shoes on his feet, and a wine gourd and a treasure bag on his waist.
At this time, he was holding a freshly pulled out dog's tail grass in his hand, and there was one in his mouth. This person is Qin Yanjun who has been practicing in the mountains for 18 years.
Jianghai.
Office of the President of Longwei Group.
Wu Moli is the president of the group. This person is 55 years old at the time. Although a person in his 50s, because he is a practitioner and takes good care of himself, he looks like he is in his early 40s.
Secretary-General Liu Ziyan stood in front of the desk. This person had worked at Longwei Group for 20 years and looked to be in his 30s. Because he took good care of himself, Wu Moli also taught him practitioners' skills. So he looks very young, but his actual age is 45 years old. She is Wu Moli's right-hand assistant. She is dedicated, responsible and absolutely loyal.
"Zi Yan, my junior brother is coming down the mountain today. I don't know when he will arrive." Wu Moli said suddenly.
Hearing the president suddenly say such a sentence, Liu Ziyan, the secretary-general, was a little surprised!
"President, you and your junior brother have never been mentioned by you?"
Wu Moli asked back: "Well! My master rescued him on the streets of Yanjing 18 years ago. Do you still remember that I told you what happened to Qin Yuyu?"
Liu Ziyan thought for a while, "President, you once talked to me about it! You said you were trying to protect a child who was being hunted, and you were rescued halfway! Could it be that your junior brother is that child?"
"Yes, Qin Yuyu is his mother's servant. Do you remember now? This time he may go to Yanjing to take revenge." Wu Moli guessed!
Liu Ziyan asked: "President, what should we do? Do we need to do some preliminary preparations?"
Wu Moli thought for a moment and said, "Let's do this! Collect as much money as possible, maybe the junior brother can use it. In addition, prepare a high-end villa for him."
After a pause, he added: "Please inform General Manager Zhu for me and ask him to come to my office."
"Okay, I'll go now." Liu Ziyan agreed, turned and left.
However, as soon as he went out, he ran into Zhu Jingrong.
"Mr. Zhu, the president asked me to inform you to go to her office." Liu Ziyan said hurriedly.
"Oh! I just want to see her too! Secretary-General Liu, did the president tell me what he wanted to see me for?"
